repaired_parse.question: is my Indigo flight from Delhi to Jaipur at 6:40 or 8:15? I've lost the email
repaired_parse.gold:
@q query
  select ?v
  where match
    relation "be at"
    role subject "my Indigo flight from Delhi to Jaipur"
    role time ?v
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare any
    ?v equal "6:40"
    ?v equal "8:15"
  end
repaired_parse.free:
@q query
  mode exists
  where match
    relation "fly from"
    role subject "the Indigo"
    role destination "Delhi"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  match
    relation "be at"
    role subject "the Indigo"
    role object "Jaipur"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare ?t1 at 6:40 PM and ?t2 at 8:15 AM
  end
repaired_parse.gbnf:

  mode exists
